summary: Full admin dashboard E2E verification (backend + frontend). Existing /app/backend/tests/test_admin.py (5 tests) all pass. Added /app/backend/tests/test_admin_extra.py (6 new tests) covering: 5-fail lockout -> 429 using BOGUS email, logout + /me 401 round-trip, feedback endpoint has no writing_content leak, audit-log accessible, users endpoint supports q/plan/page params, and secrets (ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY) not present in /app/frontend/dist bundle. All 11 backend tests pass. Frontend Playwright: /admin/login logs in with admin creds and lands on /admin; all 7 sidebar nav items (overview/users/subscriptions/writing/feedback/health/settings) correctly swap panels via data-testid='panel-<tab>'; users-search + users-plan-filter present; change-pw-form + audit-table render on Settings (audit log shows real login_success + logout entries); admin-lang-toggle switches 'Overview'<->'Resumen' instantly; no horizontal overflow at 1920px or 390px; page source contains no admin password, service role key fragment, or OpenAI key fragment.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin session accepts BOTH HttpOnly cookie (uno_admin) and Authorization: Bearer <token> — convenient for curl/tests but ensure Bearer path is still rate-limited and audit-logged identically to cookie path.

Lockout state is in-memory per backend process (per /app/backend/lib/admin_auth.py). Multi-replica deployments would weaken brute-force protection; consider moving to Supabase/Redis if horizontally scaling.

stat-card and users-table/feedback-list render conditionally after data fetch — rendering empty-state (correct) when no data; frontend QA scripts must wait for fetch before asserting counts (not a product bug).
Overview correctly labels revenue=null as 'unavailable' per spec; feedback payload inspected — no 'content' field surfaced from ai_writing_sessions.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin backend is fully covered by test_admin.py + test_admin_extra.py (11 tests, all green). Lockout is in-process memory, so running the lockout test twice back-to-back for the SAME email within 15 min would 429 immediately — current test uses timestamped bogus emails so it is safe to re-run. Frontend Playwright timings: stat-card / users-table / feedback-list render AFTER an async fetch; wait for networkidle or for the specific selector before counting.
